title: Antique Pewter Carolina Collection Triple Glass Shelf - 16 X 5 Inch Wall Mount With Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Antique Pewter, create more storage without sacrificing counter space with a traditional, three-tier glass shelf that keeps daily essentials organized, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty and available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes.

  • Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
  • Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for understated elegance
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinates easily with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories in the Carolina collection

Specs

  • Product type: Triple glass shelf (3-tier)
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection.
meta_description: Traditional triple glass shelf for bathroom storage, 16 x 5 inches with solid brass hardware and concealed wall mount. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Carolina.
